Top 5 Plumbing or HVAC Emergencies In New Jersey That Can’t Wait
We are always here to help!

Plumbing and HVAC systems are essential to the comfort, safety, and functionality of any home or business. While some issues can be scheduled for a future service appointment, others require immediate professional attention to prevent property damage, health concerns, or complete system failure.

New Jersey homeowners experience a wide range of weather conditions throughout the year, from freezing winter temperatures to hot and humid summers, making certain plumbing and HVAC emergencies especially urgent.  

Emergency Plumbing Problem?  We Can Help!

Here are five plumbing and HVAC emergencies that should never be ignored.

1. Burst Pipes

When a pipe bursts, it can discharge massive volumes of water within minutes, leading to severe damage to your walls, floors, and personal items. Turn off your main water supply right away and  Contact Us Now for help.

2. Complete Heating System Failure During Winter

When your heating system stops working during New Jersey’s cold winter months, it can rapidly create dangerous indoor temperatures and raise the possibility of pipe freezing. Contact Us Now to restore warmth and safeguard your home.

3. Clogged Pipes

When Pipes back up, contaminated water can flow into your sinks, bathtubs, and drains, presenting severe hygiene and health hazards. Emergency professional assistance is required to handle this situation properly.

4. Air Conditioning Failure During Extreme Heat

When your AC unit breaks down during scorching summer temperatures, it can make your home unbearable and potentially dangerous for at-risk family members. Rapid repair work helps bring back cooling and livable conditions.

5. Water Heater Leaks or Failure

A damaged or broken water heater can result in water destruction and interfere with everyday routines.  Contact Us Now to prevent more extensive repairs and bring back dependable hot water service.

Don’t Ignore Warning Signs

Most plumbing and HVAC emergencies begin as relatively minor issues that worsen over time when left unaddressed. Taking care of leaks, unusual sounds, inconsistent temperatures, poor airflow, and drainage problems early can help prevent major system failures, costly repairs, and extensive property damage. Regular inspections and prompt service not only improve system performance and efficiency but also reduce the likelihood of unexpected breakdowns that can disrupt your home or business. Being proactive today can save significant time, stress, and expense in the future.

About Muccia Plumbing & Heating

Muccia Plumbing, Heating & AC has proudly served Bergen County, New Jersey with trusted plumbing, heating, and air conditioning services since 1978. Founded and operated by Master Plumber Michael Muccia, the company has built a strong reputation for reliable workmanship, honest recommendations, and exceptional customer care.

Our experienced team provides comprehensive residential and commercial services, including plumbing repairs, heating systems, air conditioning, water heaters, and more. With a commitment to quality products, professional service, and customer satisfaction, Muccia Plumbing, Heating & AC treats every project with the care and attention it deserves. Homeowners throughout New Jersey can count on their experienced team for dependable comfort solutions.

Our Mission

To deliver dependable plumbing, heating, and cooling solutions with honesty, professionalism, and exceptional care. Since 1978, we have proudly served New Jersey families and businesses by combining experienced craftsmanship, quality products, and personalized service to create lasting comfort, trust, and satisfaction.

Mike Muccia, Owner and Founder

A licensed Master Plumber, Mike proudly leads Muccia Plumbing, Heating & AC as the owner and operator of a trusted New Jersey service company with a long standing commitment to quality and customer satisfaction. Since 1978, Muccia Plumbing, Heating & AC has been providing dependable plumbing, heating, and air conditioning solutions to homeowners and businesses throughout Bergen County and the surrounding communities.

Built on decades of hands on experience, the company has grown into a full service HVAC and plumbing provider dedicated to keeping homes and businesses comfortable, efficient, and operating smoothly throughout every season.

From routine maintenance and repairs to complete system installations, the Muccia Plumbing, Heating & AC team brings knowledge, professionalism, and attention to detail to every project.

Our trained and certified technicians are equipped to handle a wide range of residential and commercial needs, including plumbing services, heating system maintenance, air conditioning solutions, and much more. With a commitment to honest recommendations, quality workmanship, and exceptional service, Michael Muccia and his team continue to build lasting relationships with customers by delivering reliable solutions they can count on year after year.


A Message From Mike Muccia, Owner of Muccia Plumbing, Heating & AC

At Muccia Plumbing, Heating & AC, our customers are more than just service calls on a schedule. You are our neighbors, our community, and the families we are proud to serve. I want you to know that the health, safety, and comfort of your family are always our top priorities. When our technicians enter your home, we understand the responsibility that comes with being invited into your personal space. That is why we take every precaution to provide safe, respectful, and professional service. Our team arrives prepared with appropriate protective equipment, maintains respectful distance whenever possible, and takes extra care to clean any surfaces we touch while working in your home.

We are just as concerned about protecting your family as we are protecting our own. The truth is, our technicians have families too. We understand the importance of feeling safe and comfortable when someone enters your home, especially during uncertain times. You have trusted Muccia Plumbing, Heating & AC for decades, and that trust means everything to us. We will continue doing everything we can to provide reliable service while treating your home with the same care and respect we would expect for our own.

Thank you for allowing us to serve you and your family. We truly appreciate your trust.

Mike Muccia
Owner, Muccia Plumbing, Heating & AC


Complete Plumbing, Heating & AC Solutions You Can Trust

No matter what plumbing, heating, air conditioning, or ventilation challenge you are facing, Muccia Plumbing, Heating & AC is here to make the solution simple. Serving homeowners and businesses throughout Bergen County, we provide dependable service backed by decades of experience, skilled technicians, and a commitment to doing every job the right way.

We understand you have choices when selecting a plumbing and HVAC company, which is why we treat every service call as if it is the most important project we have ever completed. Whether we are performing a small repair, installing a new system, or handling a complex commercial project, our team delivers the same level of professionalism, attention to detail, and customer care. Our experience allows us to work efficiently, helping keep costs manageable while using quality components and proven solutions that provide lasting value. We stand behind our workmanship and take pride in providing honest recommendations, dependable repairs, and expert installations you can feel confident about.

Our Plumbing, Heating & HVAC Services Include:
Heating system cleaning, maintenance, tune ups, and seasonal preparation
Furnace, boiler, and heating system repairs and replacements
Emergency water heater repair and replacement services
Traditional tank water heater and energy efficient water heater solutions
Sump pump installation, repair, and replacement, including AC powered systems with battery backup options
Basement pump installation and bathroom drainage solutions
Complete water supply and drainage system services
Outdoor water spigot and bib valve installation and repairs
Modern faucet installation and bathroom fixture upgrades
Kitchen plumbing upgrades and sink fixture replacements
Natural gas piping installation and repairs for appliances, including ovens, dryers, and water heaters
Plumbing repairs and piping replacements to keep heating and cooling systems operating efficiently
HVAC system upgrades designed to meet or exceed New Jersey state and local municipal codes
Preventative maintenance services to help improve system performance and reliability

At Muccia Plumbing, Heating & AC, we believe quality service starts with treating every customer like a valued neighbor. From routine maintenance to emergency repairs, our goal is to provide dependable solutions that keep your home or business comfortable, safe, and running efficiently all year long.  Contact Us Today!
